department: College of Science, Engineering, and Technology (CDS&E)

deadline.value: Fall admission deadline for the Ph.D. in Data Enabled Science & Engineering is March 1, 2027 (matching the March 1 Graduate Assistantship and Tuition-waiver deadline).
deadline.quote: Fall Admission: March 1 | Ph.D. in Data Enabled Science & Engineering

also.quote: The deadline for submitting applications is March 1.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Data Science or Computer Science (ETS offers a Mathematics Subject Test, though neither the CDS&E nor Mathematics track pages require or mention any GRE exam).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The CDS&E PhD catalog pages do not state whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission (students form a doctoral advisory committee with their chosen faculty advisor after passing the Comprehensive Qualifying Examination).

funding.value: Division of Graduate Studies Graduate Assistantships (monthly stipend plus tuition for Fall and Spring) and partial/full Graduate Tuition-waivers are awarded competitively via separate application to the department chair or academic dean by March 1.
funding.quote: The Division of Graduate Studies awards assistantships each year with a monthly stipend plus tuition for one academic year: Fall and Spring... The deadline for submitting applications is March 1.

entry_route.value: Applicants may enter with either a bachelor's or master's degree in a STEM or related field (minimum 3.00 GPA on highest degree earned; 72 credit hours beyond B.S. or 48 beyond M.S.).
entry_route.quote: The applicant must have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in a STEM or Public Health Sciences, and | A minimum GPA of 3.00 (on a 4.00 scale) on the highest degree earned.

notes: Interdisciplinary Ph.D. in Computational and Data-Enabled Science & Engineering (CDS&E) with five specialized tracks: Computational Biology and Bioinformatics, Computational Mathematics and Statistical Sciences, Computational Physical Sciences, Computational Science and Engineering, and Computational Public Health Science.
